# Continuation Pass One — Discovery

The Awtsmoos renews the frame, the code, the test, the view;
Awtsmoos.com must read the living vessel before declaring what is true.

## Newly observed reality
- `apps/shared/movie/` is now the canonical interchange and AI-authoring layer.
- `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core/` is the deterministic timeline/render layer.
- `showcase/unified-movie-180/` performs shared/core bridge proof.
- Animator, Nesher Studio, Video Editor, Mitzvah Studio, and Captions retain different capability profiles.
- Multiple agents are concurrently touching this movie domain, so this pass owns only freshly read, narrowly scoped files.

## Concrete defect
`MovieIntentNormalizer.normalizeScene()` resolves a missing scene dimension to `hybrid`, but currently does not preserve that resolved dimension, passes the unresolved scene to entity adaptation, and tests the unresolved field before inserting 3D world/light layers. Dimensionless AI scenes can therefore mis-map people, shapes, and particles as 2D and lose their intended hybrid semantics.

## Discovery obligations
1. Re-read the normalizer immediately before rewrite.
2. Read the canonical validator and semantic kinds.
3. Trace shared/core bridge and deterministic evaluator.
4. Inspect 180-second showcase source and renderer.
5. Trace all studio import/adapters.
6. Inspect real media export/probe capability before claiming a rendered movie file.

## First ownership target
Whole-file rewrite `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentNormalizer.js`, preserving exports and behavior except for correct resolved-dimension propagation. Add a new regression test in the existing shared-movie test convention without rewriting concurrent test files.
